coverage_assessment: Nonexhaustive open-web scan: 21 English/Arabic queries with 419 captured result headers and 55 unique relevant URL cards, covering weekly January windows, targeted Sana’a/Aden/Taiz/Hadramawt terms and Dec/Feb boundaries. Eleven cards have opened status (seven substantive relevant articles, two later-year leads, two site-chrome-only extractions); 44 remain search-only. Three provisional candidates remain pending; none establishes a public gathering of at least 50. LexisNexis-equivalent coverage, local archive breadth, source independence, boundaries and official compatibility remain unresolved; no absence claim.
